title: Jeff Gundlach warns AI chip strategy may signal market peak
excerpt: Gundlach, the investor known as the "Bond King" questioned the wisdom of using fast-evolving technology as collateral for long-term borrowing.
content_html:
Billionaire investor Jeff Gundlach says Wall Street's bid to turn artificial-intelligence chips into an investable asset class could be a warning that risk markets are nearing a peak.

The DoubleLine Capital CEO and chief investment officer took aim at Nvidia's newly announced partnerships with six finance heavyweights, which are intended to mobilize more than $500 billion for AI infrastructure.

Nvidia said last week that it had signed memoranda of understanding with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR to create financing platforms for its customers.

In a press release, the chipmaker said the capital would help companies fund access to Nvidia chips and broader "AI factories," while its partners pitched compute as long-lived infrastructure suitable for institutional investors.

Gundlach was unconvinced.

The investor, known as the "Bond King," questioned the wisdom of using fast-evolving technology as collateral for long-term borrowing.

"Assets of unknown life as collateral for long term debt?" he wrote on X, adding that the consortium plan "will not likely age well."

Gundlach compared the idea to issuing 30-year asset-backed securities against warehouses of bananas, even if they were "newly engineered bananas of unknown life."

NVDA $500B fund (not to be confused with funding) consortium plan will not likely age well. Assets of unknown life as collateral for long term debt? Why not do a 30 year ABS deal backed by warehouses of bananas? It’s OK, they’ll be newly engineered bananas of unknown life.

— Jeffrey Gundlach (@TruthGundlach) August 15, 2026

Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Business Insider.

Gundlach's argument largely centered on a mismatch between the debt's duration and how long the chips remain valuable.

AI processors can generate strong cash flow while demand is high, but given the rapid technological advances in AI, there are concerns that today's chips could lose value before the loans that financed them are paid off.

In a separate post on Saturday, Gundlach said no one "rings a bell" at the top of risk markets. Still, he suggested investors should watch for proclamations of new asset classes built on financial innovation and aided by what he called "questionable" credit ratings.

It is said noone “rings a bell” at risk market tops, but there are declarations of “new asset classes involving ‘financial innovation’ abetted by questionable ratings” to watch out for.

— Jeffrey Gundlach (@TruthGundlach) August 15, 2026

Mark Cuban offered his own terse comparison: "Chips as an asset class will be the new crypto."

Chips as an asset class will be the new crypto

— Mark Cuban (@mcuban) August 15, 2026

Gundlach's message echoes an argument frequently made by Michael Burry, the "The Big Short" investor, in recent months. Burry — who has been a vocal critic of what he sees as an AI bubble and publicly shorted a number of AI companies — has long argued that tech giants are overinvesting in microchips that will quickly become obsolete as the tech evolves.

亿万富翁投资者杰夫·冈拉克表示，华尔街试图将人工智能芯片转变为可投资的资产类别，这可能是对风险市场已接近顶峰的警告。

英伟达上周表示，已与阿波罗、贝莱德、黑石、布鲁克菲尔德、高盛和 KKR 签署了谅解备忘录，为其客户创建融资平台。

这家芯片制造商在一份新闻稿中表示，这笔资金将帮助企业为使用英伟达芯片和更广泛的“人工智能工厂”提供资金，而其合作伙伴则将计算视为适合机构投资者的长期基础设施。

冈拉克并不相信。

这位被称为“债券之王”的投资者质疑使用快速发展的技术作为长期借款抵押品是否明智。

“寿命未知的资产作为长期债务的抵押品？” 他在 X 上写道，并补充说该联盟计划“不太可能顺利实施”。

冈拉克将这个想法比作以香蕉仓库发行 30 年期资产支持证券，即使它们是“生命未知的新设计香蕉”。

NVDA $500B 基金（不要与资金混淆）财团计划不太可能过时。 寿命未知的资产作为长期债务的抵押品？ 为什么不进行一项由香蕉仓库支持的 30 年期 ABS 交易？ 没关系，它们将是生命未知的新工程香蕉。——杰弗里·冈拉克 (Jeffrey Gundlach) (@TruthGundlach) 2026 年 8 月 15 日

英伟达没有立即回应《商业内幕》的置评请求。

冈拉克的论点主要集中在债务期限与筹码保值时间之间的不匹配。

人工智能处理器可以在需求旺盛的情况下产生强劲的现金流，但鉴于人工智能技术的快速进步，人们担心当今的芯片可能会在偿还其融资贷款之前贬值。

冈拉克在周六的另一篇文章中表示，没有人在风险市场的顶部“敲响警钟”。 尽管如此，他建议投资者应该关注基于金融创新并在他所说的“有问题的”信用评级的帮助下宣布的新资产类别。

据说没有人在风险市场顶部“敲响警钟”，但有一些声明称“涉及‘金融创新’的新资产类别受到可疑评级的怂恿”，值得警惕。——杰弗里·冈拉克 (Jeffrey Gundlach) (@TruthGundlach) 2026 年 8 月 15 日

马克·库班（Mark Cuban）提供了他自己的简洁比较：“芯片作为一种资产类别将成为新的加密货币。”

芯片作为一种资产类别将成为新的加密货币——Mark Cuban (@mcuban) 2026 年 8 月 15 日

冈拉克的信息呼应了“大空头”投资者迈克尔·伯里近几个月来经常提出的论点。 伯里一直直言不讳地批评他所认为的人工智能泡沫，并公开做空了多家人工智能公司。他长期以来一直认为，科技巨头在微芯片上过度投资，随着技术的发展，这些芯片很快就会过时。
